Employed MCP 1.2.0 triage
Judgement: BENIGN. Node bins invoke bundled Python without a shell.
The Python client accesses its own credentials, performs loopback OAuth
with state checking, queries the configured jobs API and saves requested
exports. MCP dispatch exposes job/account tools, not arbitrary execution.
The Python 3.12 cache was disassembled using xdis after rizin crashed;
its nested code objects, imports, constants and operations agree with source.
No install lifecycle hook, hidden payload, credential sweep or exfiltration.

Corrections: require card context for Visa; move generic API-key reads
from ai-provider to secret-name and preserve the credential read consumer.
MCP environment text is a configuration reference, not a proven renderer.
Repository directive fragments name their actual tokens, not an inferred
agent instruction. Matchers and parent selector membership are preserved.

Controls: card-positive must match major card network; visa-near-miss
must not. env-positive must match secret-name API read and its credential
rollup; env-near-miss must not match the API-key read. All tested with
cleave test-rules and archive rescanning using the current traits.
